# The Future Trait and Async Basics
Asynchronous Rust uses cooperative multitasking where tasks yield execution rather than blocking threads:

```rust
// The core Future trait in std
// pub trait Future {
//     type Output;
//     fn poll(self: Pin<&mut Self>, cx: &mut Context<'_>) -> Poll<Self::Output>;
// }

async fn compute_async_val() -> u32 {
    42
}
```
